params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-work-canonical"; git -C $repo fetch --prune origin; if((git -C $repo status --porcelain).Length -ne 0){ throw 'canonical checkout dirty; refusing sync' }; if((git -C $repo branch --show-current).Trim() -ne 'main'){ throw 'canonical checkout not on main' }; git -C $repo merge --ff-only origin/main; Write-Output "HEAD=$(git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD)"; Write-Output "VERSION=$(Get-Content (Join-Path $repo 'VERSION.txt') -Raw)"; Write-Output 'LOG_BEGIN'; git -C $repo log -12 --oneline --decorate; Write-Output 'LOG_END'; Write-Output 'STATUS_BEGIN'; git -C $repo status --short --branch; Write-Output 'STATUS_END'
